description: This file defines the DetailFragment class, which handles displaying detailed information about a single tourist attraction within an Android app. It manages UI components, loads images, handles navigation, and retrieves attraction data from static content.

classes.name: DetailFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that displays details for a tourist attraction, including image, description, distance, and a map link.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's view, sets UI components, loads attraction data, and sets up click handlers.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation up actions in the options menu, enabling proper back-stack management and transitions.

methods.name: findAttraction
methods.description: Searches static content to find an Attraction object by name.
